note: BMCI, which lists branches in the territory in its own branch finder (read 2026-10-31: Laayoune, Angle Boulevard Mekka et Boulevard Omar Ibn Elkhattab n° 25, and Dakhla, Boulevard Ahmed Benchakroun): its banking price list for retail customers from 12 March 2026 (the file dated 4 September 2025 in its name, linked from its home page) charges 65 dirhams a quarter to keep a cheque account (Compte Chèques, the individual's everyday account; a current account is 75), before tax; the VAT added isn't given on the sheet, so isn't added. The sheet is the bank's for Morocco as a whole; it names no other price for its branches in the territory.
